scope: Bound file and browser-copy role restoration and prevent closed continuations from reaching later SDK stages
behavior: Role file restore has a three-minute deadline across file read, decryption and connected restoration. Browser copies have a separate three-minute local read/decryption deadline followed by a three-minute restoration phase.
Workspace lifetime and deadline checks precede installation. Connected restoration passes a guard through wallet setup, SDK join, public read and each saved disclosure verification.
Expired browser decryptions do not call onRestore or bind autosave. Timeout preserves restore inputs for explicit retry; normal offline and connected authority/report checks remain intact.

unit.scope: Six new file/browser restore cases plus three SDK-stage continuation cases; complete RoleWorkspace, LocalRoleStorage and role-network regression.

initialBuild.reason: A new Testing Library query used Playwright-only exact option. Removed the unsupported option; production code was unchanged by that correction.

browser.scope: Four new desktop/mobile file and real IndexedDB copy cases hold real PBKDF2 key results past virtual expiry, reject late decryption and restore successfully on explicit retry. Existing role-draft file/browser recovery also passes.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: SDK continuation tests use mocked providers/sessions. Browser tests use undeployed role backups, real crypto/storage and a virtual clock, not a native-wallet ceremony or physical suspend.
Already-started wallet/SDK/crypto work is not cancelled; guards prevent further application continuation.
Other role-network callers retain their existing behavior unless they pass the optional continuation guard.
No full regression, runtime-image refresh or public deployment.
